name: hash-text
description:
The hash of the text as lower-case hex, of its UTF-8 bytes. An empty text has a hash too (md5 «d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e»).

algorithm: "md5" or "sha256".

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

Example: semkit read core.csv hash-text write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
